model.name: R19.81: Pinch-zoom works in the preview iframe, not just pan.
model.description: BUG: pan gesture works in the preview iframe but pinch-zoom does nothing. FIX: the preview iframe MUST support pinch-zoom (two-finger zoom on touch devices). This may require touch-action CSS on the iframe or a gesture handler that translates pinch events into CSS transform scale on the iframe content. Both pan AND pinch must work for the preview to be usable on mobile.
model.tronQuote: > TRON: "pan is working well in the iframe but pinch not at all."
model.crossRefNote: R19.65 (ContentPreviewer) is the component. R19.81 adds pinch-zoom to the iframe render path alongside existing pan.
